purpose: Original unified labelling for discussions, issues and PRs: label sync, template-label guardrail, actions/labeler file/branch rules, labelling agent, Markdown report and optional report commit.
triggers: pull_request: branches [develop], types [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, labeled, unlabeled]
issues: types [opened, edited, reopened, labeled, unlabeled, transferred]
discussion: types [created, edited, answered, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs.summary: Checkout develop, setup Node, `npm ci || true`, label-sync.js, check-template-labels.js (continue-on-error), actions/labeler on PRs (sync-labels), labeling.agent.js, report-writer.js, upload report, optional commit and push to develop.

failure_points.issue: Triggers on labeled/unlabeled for issues and PRs; a bulk relabel queues one run per change (labeling-unified.yml:7-9 records ~660 runs in #3531, with stale payloads undoing manual changes).
Concurrency key uses github.event.number, which exists only on PR events, so every issue event got its own group (documented at labeling-unified.yml:27-29).
Always checks out ref develop, so PR runs use develop's labeler config rather than the PR's.
`npm ci || true` hides install failures; js-yaml is then installed ad hoc twice.
label-sync.js has no entrypoint, so the sync step is a no-op.
report-writer.js throws ReferenceError under ESM, failing the job after the agent ran.
report_commit pushes to develop with contents: read only.
dry_run has no effect: the agent's direct-run guard calls runLabelingAgent() without options and dryRun comes only from opts.
Discussion events trigger the job but the agent handles only issues and PRs.

overlaps_with: labeling-governance.yml (identical triggers; its standard-labeling job is marked 'from labeling.yml')
